## Où j'en suis

Draft PR #57 (kestrel-analytics/infra) opened with the pg17 blue/green work for staging: postgres17 parameter group, blue/green enabled on analytics-staging, prod prepared behind `pg17_enabled = false`, AWS provider pinned `~> 5.82.0`. Plans are clean (staging 1 to add / 1 to change, prod no changes); nothing applied.

- [en-cours] Staging apply is waiting on the pg_partman upgrade (4.7.4 → 5.1.0 must run on 16.4 first, then verify `run_maintenance_proc()` on `events_raw` / `events_daily`) — todo only, nothing run against the DB.
- [prochaine-étape] Run the pg_partman upgrade on staging, then apply staging plan.
- [prochaine-étape] Pick the production window after Maya's sign-off, avoiding the nightly dbt lock on `events_daily` (01:00–03:30 UTC); candidate slots are Sat/Sun 04:00–06:00 UTC.
- [essai-raté] `terraform init` with the bumped constraint pulled AWS provider v6 → 37 unrelated changes (S3 ACL, `aws_eip.vpc`); fixed by pinning `~> 5.82.0`.
- [essai-raté] Proposed prod cutover Sat 28 Nov 02:00 UTC falls inside the dbt lock; discarded.
- [question] Prod date still undecided, pending Maya's sign-off.
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off, and `apply_immediately` stays false on prod (source: t14)
- [décision] Pin the AWS provider to 5.82, no v6 in this PR (source: t04)
